build_linear_solver_config: build a LinearThetaMethod solver config with theta_implicit, convection modes, and tridiagonal solver type
build_newton_raphson_solver: build a NewtonRaphsonThetaMethod solver config with max iterations, residual tolerance, and initial guess mode
build_optimizer_solver_config: build an OptimizerThetaMethod solver config with max iterations, loss tolerance, and initial guess mode
build_runtime_params: build runtime params from a solver config for linear or nonlinear theta method simulation
build_solver_from_config: build a solver instance from a pydantic config and models object
